messages:
Alex: CI perf alert on serving-runtime after merge 0f4b9c8 — decode p50 up ~30% for >4k seqs, job #4912 flagged. ci-bot: [perf-ci] regression detected: serving.decode_latency.p50 +31% on job 4912 (https://ci.internal/reports/4912) :warning:
Alex: I reproduced on g4.8x with model-x. Quick flamegraph shows attention decode switching to fallback attention kernel mid-request.
Sam: can you dump the kernel selector log?
Alex: paste:```kernel_selector: chosen=fallback_attention_sparse
batching: policy=conservative_mixed_shapes
kv: prefix_dedupe=disabled
```
Taylor: did we change kernel gating or fused-op heuristics in the last merge? @Maria any PRs touching batching/ops?
Maria: I merged batching-mix-v2 (PR #2314) earlier today. It adds a conservative path for mixed-length batches to avoid OOM and flips several flags to protect fused ops.
Sam: microbench (local, same infra): baseline tokens/s=56.8 p50=92ms, after-merge tokens/s=40.9 p50=128ms (approx -28%).
Alex: KV hit-rate in traces drops from ~92% to ~12% when conservative_mixed_shapes is enabled. Looks like prefix dedupe was turned off.
Maria: ugh — I included a defensive disable for prefix_dedupe to avoid offset-shadowing bugs but forgot to gate it behind a safer check. There's a TODO but it slipped.
Taylor: we need a quick mitigation. Can we re-enable prefix dedupe for the conservative path? Is it safe?
Sam: quick local patch: set prefix_dedupe=true for conservative_mixed_shapes and run microbench.
Sam: patched results: tokens/s=55.9 p50=95ms — back within noise of baseline.
Infra-bot: starting build for hotfix/prefix-dedupe branch (#4918).
ci-bot: [perf-ci] running regression-suite on hotfix/prefix-dedupe (#4918).
Maria: I'll open a revert PR for batching-mix-v2 and then rework the heuristic with explicit KV-safe mode and tests.
Alex: bisect log shows commit 0f4b9c8 (merge PR 2314) as first bad.
Sam: git bisect summary:
```
good: 0f1b2c3 (before PR)
bad: 0f4b9c8 (merge PR 2314)
```
Taylor: ops: revert PR #2314 immediately, then reintroduce with KV checks. Maria, please add perf/regression unit that exercises mixed-length batches + asserts kv cache hit rate.
Maria: will do. Also adding an integration perf-test that runs on PRs flagged as touching batching or KV.
Alex: filing incident ticket INC-2034 with traces and flamegraphs. Save relevant traces and host links there.
Sam: saved trace snippets and perf diffs to INC-2034.
ci-bot: [perf-ci] hotfix branch results: decode p50 ~ -1% vs baseline, job #4918 passed.
Infra-bot: revert PR scheduled to auto-merge once CI green. :white_check_mark: 
Maria: apologies for the regression. I'll add a pre-merge perf check and a checklist item in PR template: "verify prefix_kv_dedupe behavior for mixed batching".
Alex: thanks. Postmortem follow-ups: 1) Add unit test for kv prefix dedupe under mixed shapes, 2) Add perf gate in CI for serving.decode_latency on long-seq jobs, 3) Docs note in batching heuristics about interactions with fused ops.
Taylor: Added to eng-runtime backlog. Closing thread once revert lands. :thumbsup:
